description: Shares authority among public institutions workers communities and affected publics.
Resources affected communities to define futures risks priorities and adaptation pathways.
Representative deliberative processes for complex long-term public choices.
Connects democratic futures to capital budgets resilience investment and implementation tracking.
Creates public review audit and rights mechanisms for emerging technologies.
Tracks public input recommendations institutional responses implementation and reasons for non-adoption.
Brings youth voice future generations and long-horizon accountability into public institutions.
